description: Dept of Trade and Investment Policy - Order to impose Special Commodity Levy, Semi-milled or wholly milled rice, Raw Rice, Nadu Rice, Samba Rice etc. for a Period from 31.05.2017 to 31.08.2017
categorisation: This gazette content is an order issued under the Special Commodity Levy Act, No. 48 of 2007, imposing specific levy rates on commodities. It constitutes a regulatory instrument that modifies or implements existing legislation, which falls squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5). While it mentions Minister Mangala Samaraweera by name and title, it does not describe his portfolio responsibilities in detail (only stating his existing title), and the primary purpose is regulatory/legal rather than about government personnel or structure.
